svg.title: The primary seed already compares; linear projection, residual/rebate bounds and common keeper extension give core convergence and arbitrarily small collected remainder on the original input book. Local insertion differences keep common coefficient supports and orientation; append the negative second labelled remainder to the first to form a legitimate difference. If each pair has summable common bound fi, its difference costs at most 2fi. For target r > 0, choose finite E with P i/∈E 2fi ≤r/2 and eventually use r/[2(|E| + 1)] on each index in E.
